data.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
data.detailed_description:
In a narrow, cobblestone street of 16th-century France, you open the doors of your very own flower shop. Sow your seeds at first light, nurture your blooms with care, and sell the finest bouquets to passing customers. Every flower holds a secret, and every day brings a new order.

🌱 From Seed to Bloom

Each flower has its own needs — light, water, fertilizer, soil, pruning and pest control. Use your trowel, watering can, pruning shears and spray to raise your plants in just the right conditions. The better your care, the higher the flower's quality and value.

🏪 A Shop of Your Own

Buy shelves and displays from merchants and arrange your shop however you like. Showcase your flowers, fulfill each customer's request, and grow a business that earns more as your quality rises.

📖 Many Flowers & a Guide Book

From daisies to roses, tulips to lavender, dozens of species await. Study your guide book to learn how to grow each one, and unlock new varieties as your level and coin allow.

⭐ Master Your Craft

Every flower you sell earns experience. Level up, earn titles like "Flower Master," and gain access to rarer flowers and tools.

🌇 A Living Town

As the sun drifts across the sky, the streets fill with life — passersby, horse carts and old French houses lit by torchlight. All in first person, at your own peaceful pace.

Your progress saves automatically — pick up right where you left off.

data.short_description: Grow, nurture and sell exquisite flowers from your own shop in old France. Plant seeds, tend each bloom with care, master dozens of species, and build a thriving florist as customers come seeking the perfect bouquet — all in first person, at your own peaceful pace.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB (DX11, 6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p / 30 FPS, Low–Medium settings. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 8GB / AMD RX 6600 XT 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1440p / 60 FPS, High settings. SSD required.
